question: Which of the following Indian Players has scored maximum runs in Cricket World Cup 1983?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kapil Dev.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kapil Dev **was the captain of the** Indian cricket team** that won the **World Cup in 1983.**
 
• He scored a total of** 303 runs** in the tournament, which was the** highest **by any Indian player. 
 
• Kapil Dev's innings of **175* against Zimbabwe** in the group stage was one of the best innings in the history of World Cup cricket. 
 
• Kapil Dev was also a key bowler for India in the tournament, taking **12 wickets in 8 matches **at an **economy rate of 3.71. **
 
• Kapil Dev's all-round performance in the tournament was crucial in India's triumph in the **World Cup 1983.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SM Gavaskar **was a part of the Indian cricket team that won the World Cup in 1983, but he did not score the maximum runs in the tournament.
 
• **K. Srikkanth **was the highest run-scorer for India in the final of the World Cup 1983, but he did not score the maximum runs in the entire tournament.
 
• **SM Patil **played a crucial knock of **51 runs** in the semi-final against England, but he did not score the maximum runs in the tournament.
